title: Homograph phishing tsaron
summary: Haruffa masu kamanni suna ƙirƙira yankuna na hukuma don girbi sa hannun hannu ko iri.

sections.heading: Me yayi kama
sections.body: Maharan suna musanya haruffa iri ɗaya na gani zuwa yankuna kuma suna haɗa su da tallace-tallace ko DMs. UI na iya zama cikakke-pixel kuma har ma yana nuna ma'aunin karya.

sections.heading: Yadda ake gane shi
sections.body: Buga URLs ko amfani da alamun shafi. Bincika masu takaddun shaida. Kar a taɓa danna babban tallan bincike na walat/gadaji. Tsayar da hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa kuma bincika ƙananan yanki.

sections.heading: Idan kun danna
sections.body: Soke yarda kuma matsar da sauran kudade. Idan ka buga iri, wannan walat ɗin yana ƙonewa-ceto zuwa sabon iri kawai. Ajiye shaida don rahotanni.

checklist: Ketare-bincike kan na'ura ta biyu don girman girma
Kada a taɓa buga iri cikin shafukan yanar gizo
body: Haruffa masu kamanni suna ƙirƙira yankuna na hukuma don girbi sa hannun hannu ko iri.

title: Cikakken jagorar jimlar iri
summary: Zuriyar ku ita ce sarrafa kadarorin. Duk wanda ya roke shi makiya ne.

sections.heading: Ajiyayyen
sections.body: Rubuta hannu da sake duba oda; la'akari da faranti na karfe; raba wurare a hankali. Babu hotuna, gajimare, ko aikace-aikacen taɗi.

sections.heading: Zamba
sections.body: "Aiki tare / tabbatarwa / haɓakawa / cirewa / iska" shafukan neman kalmomi 12/24. Fake Discord admins suna amfani da rubutun iri ɗaya. Hardware “masu duba gaskiya” suna neman iri karya ne.

sections.heading: Gado
sections.body: Idan babu wanda ya san shirin, kuɗi ya mutu tare da ku. Yi amfani da umarnin rufe, lauyoyi, ko multisig. A kan abin da ake zargin ya zubo, yi ƙaura nan da nan.

checklist: Tsari kawai akan kafofin watsa labarai na layi
Kar a taɓa shigar da su akan na'urar sadarwar
Yi ƙaura akan kowace siginar ɗigo
body: Zuriyar ku ita ce sarrafa kadarorin. Duk wanda ya roke shi makiya ne.

title: Amincewa / ba da izini tarko
summary: Amincewa ba sa motsa alamun nan da nan - suna ba da izinin magudanar ruwa daga baya, musamman marasa iyaka.

sections.heading: Makanikai
sections.body: Canja wurin ERC-20 Daga izinin buƙatun. Amincewa marar iyaka sun dace; masu kashe makudan kudi na iya kwashe ku daga baya. setApprovalForAll shine NFT daidai.

sections.heading: Aiki lafiya
sections.body: Madaidaicin izini idan zai yiwu; soke akai-akai; gwada sabbin ka'idoji ƙanana. Kalli rukunin yanar gizo waɗanda ke buƙatar Amincewa da farko.

sections.heading: Amsa da ya faru
sections.body: Soke kuma motsa kuɗi. Ba da fifiko ga masu kashe kuɗi mai suna a cikin bayanan hack.

checklist: Ki yarda mara iyaka mara amfani
Soke masu aikin NFT da ba a yi amfani da su ba
Ba da fifiko ga masu kashe kujerun yarjejeniya
body: Amincewa ba sa motsa alamun nan da nan - suna ba da izinin magudanar ruwa daga baya, musamman marasa iyaka.

title: Aikace-aikacen walat ɗin karya
summary: Clones suna bayyana a cikin shaguna da tashoshi masu ɗaukar nauyi don satar iri ko na'urorin sarrafa nesa.

sections.heading: Haɓaka karya
sections.body: Daidaita sunayen masu bugawa zuwa matsayi na hukuma; Hattara sabbin manhajoji na #1. Fi son hanyoyin haɗi daga ainihin rukunin yanar gizon. APKs masu ɗorewa sun fi haɗari.

sections.heading: Taurare
sections.body: Ci gaba da sabunta OS; rage girman plugins; la'akari da sadaukarwa waya. Yi amfani da kayan aiki don girma. Shirya makullin nesa idan wayar ta ɓace.

sections.heading: Bayan shigar
sections.body: Idan an shigar da iri a cikin ƙa'idar karya, ɗauka sulhu kuma yi ƙaura akan na'ura mai tsabta.

checklist: Girman nau'i-nau'i tare da kayan aiki yana tabbatarwa
Yi hijira nan da nan idan karya
body: Clones suna bayyana a cikin shaguna da tashoshi masu ɗaukar nauyi don satar iri ko na'urorin sarrafa nesa.

title: Magudanar sa hannu & izini na mugunta
summary: Babu iri da ake buƙata - sa hannun tsararrun ɓarna na iya ba da izinin magudanar ruwa.

sections.heading: Dabaru
sections.body: Neman mints/da'awar karya saitinApprovalForAll, izini, ko "shigarwa." Wasu lodin kaya ba komai bane. Bots suna sharewa daga baya.

sections.heading: Tsaro
sections.body: Share-hannun walat, kwaikwaiyo, ƙin abubuwan da ba a sani ba. Haɗa sabbin shafuka tare da mai ƙonewa da farko. Duba yankuna.

sections.heading: Bayan haka
sections.body: Soke, kuɗaɗen ceto, gargaɗi al'umma, bincika sauran sarƙoƙi don amincewa iri ɗaya.

checklist: Yi amfani da ƙonawa akan sababbin shafuka
body: Babu iri da ake buƙata - sa hannun tsararrun ɓarna na iya ba da izinin magudanar ruwa.

title: Tallafin karya & injiniyan zamantakewa
summary: Bayan kun buga kuskure, masu kwaikwayi DM “taimako” suna neman samun dama mai nisa ko iri.

sections.heading: Littafin wasan kwaikwayo
sections.body: Cloned avatars, gaggawa, aikace-aikacen sarrafa nesa, ko umarnin ajiya na "kwangiloli lafiya". Matsalolin abokan hulɗa da aka yi sulhu suna yada hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa kuma.

sections.heading: Dokoki
sections.body: Ƙungiyoyin gaske da wuya su fara DM don asirce. Yi amfani da tikiti na hukuma/tashoshi na jama'a. Tabbatar da abokai ba sa cikin band.

sections.heading: Tsafta
sections.body: Kar a taɓa manna tsaba a cikin tashoshi na jama'a-har ma da “bangare abin rufe fuska.”

checklist: Yi watsi da tallafin sanyi DMs
Kar a shigar da kayan aikin nesa bazuwar
Kar a taɓa ba da iri don tallafawa
Tabbatar da mahaɗan abokai masu ban mamaki a layi
Yi amfani da tashoshi na taimakon jama'a
body: Bayan kun buga kuskure, masu kwaikwayi DM “taimako” suna neman samun dama mai nisa ko iri.

title: Gada aminci
summary: Gada sune manyan maƙasudin hack da fi so phishing. Mafi sauri ba shi da aminci ta tsohuwa.

sections.heading: Zabar
sections.body: Fi son gadoji na canonical daga takaddun hukuma. Vet gada masu sauri don dubawa da iyakoki. Fahimtar jinkirin fita.

sections.heading: Aiki
sections.body: Ƙananan gwaje-gwaje na ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe; tabbatar da kwangilar alamar makoma; ajiye hashes. Kada ku ɗauki ficewar cikin jirgin a matsayin gefe kyauta.

sections.heading: Abubuwan da suka faru
sections.body: A kan hacking ɗin gada, bi sanarwar dakatarwa na hukuma-ba DM “rubutun ƙaura ba.”

checklist: Yi watsi da rubutun ƙaura na DM
body: Gada sune manyan maƙasudin hack da fi so phishing. Mafi sauri ba shi da aminci ta tsohuwa.

title: Na'ura & Tsaftar burauza
summary: Clipboard malware, kari na karya, da kwamfutocin da aka raba su ne hanyoyin sata na yau da kullun.

sections.heading: Browser
sections.body: Ƙaddamar da bayanin martaba na crypto; ƙaramin kari na hukuma; shafukan alamar shafi. Yi amfani da injin mai tsabta don girman girman.

sections.heading: Tsari
sections.body: Patch OS; yi hattara "kayan aikin iska"; kauce wa sketchy jama'a caja. Koyaushe sake duba adiresoshin da aka liƙa.

sections.heading: Yadawa
sections.body: Zafi na yau da kullun, sanyi don tanadi, multisig don taskoki ya doke babban walat ɗaya.

checklist: Sake duba adiresoshin da aka liƙa
body: Clipboard malware, kari na karya, da kwamfutocin da aka raba su ne hanyoyin sata na yau da kullun.
